stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

posts.text: As chairman of the @HouseVetAffairs Committee, I was honored to stand side-by-side with @SpeakerJohnson for a special, bipartisan Veterans Day tribute on the steps of the U.S. Capitol. https://t.co/FY7enJiv5H

I’m excited to report the House has PASSED my Take Care of America’s Veterans Act! 

This historic package of veterans legislation delivers long overdue reforms to strengthen veterans’ healthcare, expand benefits, and cut through VA bureaucracy. 

Our veterans kept their promise https://t.co/dCWy7GR58c
To all of Southern Illinois’ veterans and their families, I say thank you. Happy Veterans Day. https://t.co/bL2ArZDElg

Happy Veterans Day! Today, we honor the brave men and women who answered the call to serve our great nation. 

Freedom comes at a price, and we owe a debt of gratitude that can never be repaid. 

To every veteran across Southern Illinois and our nation, thank you for your service https://t.co/9CJhJ8FiQ5

Happy 251st Birthday to the United States Marine Corps! 

As a proud Marine, I appreciate the courage, discipline, and commitment of the generations of men and women who have answered the call to defend our nation and protect our freedoms. 

Semper Fi! https://t.co/42aXToLsnA

Congratulations to Edgar Garcia from Murphysboro High School, for winning first place, and Cameron Roedl from Toledo High School for taking second place in the 3 mile run at the IHSA XC State Championships! Your dedication and hard work has made your entire community proud! https://t.co/7C0eWsRa1d

I’m proud to announce more than $32 million in federal funding for SIH and SSM Health group to reimburse for significant costs incurred during COVID.

Southern Illinois hospitals stepped up during the pandemic when we needed them most, straining their budgets along the way.

Congratulations to Twelve Oaks Vineyard in Carlyle on winning the Governor’s Cup for Best Red Wine, the top award for Best White Wine, and two additional gold medals from the Illinois Wine Competition. 

It’s great to see a Southern Illinois small business earning statewide recognition for its hard work, dedication, and great wine!

Southern Illinois manufacturers need every opportunity to grow, expand, and create good-paying jobs. 

The Working Families Tax Cuts restored permanent 100% first-year expensing for qualifying business investments. 

That’s one less obstacle standing in the way of American manufacturing. We should be rewarding businesses for investing in America, not burying them in red tape and taxes.

From waitresses and bartenders to hardworking service industry employees across Southern Illinois, tips are an important part of making a living. 

The Working Families Tax Cuts allow eligible workers to deduct up to $25,000 in qualified tips annually. 

President Trump and Republicans remain committed to delivering on promises. No tax on tips!

Great meeting in Mt. Vernon with Diamond Equipment and Associated Equipment Distributors to discuss workforce development, infrastructure, and the challenges facing our farmers and equipment dealers. 

Family owned businesses like Diamond Equipment keep America building, and I’ll keep fighting to help them succeed.

Democrats are fine with requiring identification to board a plane, drive a car, and countless other everyday activities. 

But requiring photo ID when voting in federal elections and registering to vote? That’s a line too far for the left.

Make it make sense.

American elections are for American citizens. PERIOD. 

That's why I cosponsored the SAVE AMERICA Act to require proof of citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections. 

Every lawful vote deserves to count, and every American deserves confidence in our elections.

If you’re tuning in for Game 1 of the World Series tonight, keep an eye on the Brewers’ dugout. Former Saluki baseball player Evan Martin is headed to the Fall Classic as Milwaukee’s Game Preparation Specialist. Southern Illinois is proud to see SIU-Carbondale represented on baseball’s biggest stage. Best of luck!

Southern Illinois’ railroads have always played an important role in keeping America’s economy moving. 

I’m proud to have helped secure $25.1 million in federal funding for Evansville Western Railway to improve 124.5 miles of freight rail infrastructure. 

I’m excited to see this investment coming to our region because it means stronger infrastructure, safer rail operations, and more opportunities for the hardworking folks who call Southern Illinois home.

Huge win for job growth, manufacturing, and the hardworking folks who feed and fuel America. I’m thrilled to see this major investment coming into Marissa!

Thank you @VP and @SecRollins for your commitment to strengthening American agriculture! https://t.co/carsMMGrBz

That’s why I cosponsored H.R. 38, the Constitutional Concealed Carry Reciprocity Act, to protect the rights of law-abiding gun owners traveling across state lines. 

I’ll never stop fighting to defend our right to keep and bear arms.
